title: Government announces new border enforcement policy
summary: Officials said the policy takes effect next month and affects asylum seekers at the southern border.

title: Border chaos: administration slams critics as illegal aliens surge
summary: The new policy comes amid a surge of illegal aliens, officials blasts opponents.

title: Migrants face crisis as historic border crackdown begins
summary: Rights groups called the enforcement policy a crisis for asylum seekers and announced a protest march.

title: New border policy sparks backlash and calls for resignation
summary: Demonstrators plan a rally against the border enforcement policy affecting immigrants.

title: Protesters killed in clashes at capital demonstration
summary: At least three people died in clashes between demonstrators and security forces.

title: Security forces kill three protesters as regime cracks down on rally
summary: Witnesses said security forces opened fire on demonstrators during a rally against the government.

title: Rioters clash with police, mob torches vehicles in capital
summary: A mob of rioters clashed with police during violent scenes at the demonstration.

title: Central bank holds interest rates steady
summary: The central bank kept rates unchanged citing stable inflation.
